what: The ask's output quotes only the first lines of a failing test's panic, so a count assertion whose message puts the profile after a newline (owners_tests.rs:39, store_worktree_tests.rs:200) showed no cause.
cost: an edit per test putting the profile rows on the first line and another queued ask (about ten minutes each)
cause: the runner trims each failure to its head lines
workaround: put the evidence on the assertion message's first line
fix: runner.py writes each failed test's whole panic text to a file it names in the ask's output
